title: Fix Landing page CTA routing for signed-in users

requirements.text: Update the Landing page CTA buttons so that clicking "Get Started" or "Order Now" routes authenticated users to the Dashboard instead of the Sign In page; unauthenticated users should still be routed to Sign In.

quotes: when clicking get started or order it tries to redirect to sign in if they are already signed in redirect to dashboard so they can place a order if they  want

acceptanceCriteria: When the user is authenticated (Internet Identity identity is present), clicking the Landing page "Get Started" button navigates to /dashboard.
When the user is authenticated, clicking the Landing page "Order Now" button navigates to /dashboard.
When the user is not authenticated, clicking either Landing page button navigates to /signin.
This change is implemented in frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx and does not require changes to the auth provider hooks in immutable paths.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Keep all changes within the existing React Router (@tanstack/react-router) navigation approach already used in the app.
nonGoals: Do not change backend authentication or authorization behavior.
Do not change protected-route behavior in AuthGate (e.g., do not implement automatic redirects from AuthGate to /signin).
Do not alter the Sign In page’s existing post-auth redirect logic unless required to satisfy the CTA routing behavior.
